rules: Real-money collector items: shown with a $ price, the gold card border and the REAL CASH tag; bought through the existing Stripe checkout; refunds revoke the item.

Limited numbered editions: editionSize per item (100 per drop for the first eight; 50, 50, 25 and 10 for the yacht, crown, jet and mansion; the plaza statue is one per week). The edition number shows on the item and on the owner's profile ('No. 0042 of 100'). Limits are real; never fake scarcity.
Pure status, no gameplay advantage: the Velocity Veloce travels exactly like any other owned car; clout equals the most expensive C$ item in the same category, never more.
Net worth: value is 1.5x the most expensive C$ item in the same Shop category (existing rule), and collector items DO count toward the net worth leaderboard (owner decision).
Not tradable, not sellable for C$, and not giftable for now.
Owning any piece earns a 'Clout Couture' badge. Each new drop gets a Lola Lowdown News item.

The only home in this collection is the Waterfront Mansion, and it has a weekly C$ upkeep equal to the top Astoria rent, because owning a home normally stops rent and real money must never buy an economic advantage.
Map items (yacht, jet, plaza statue) and the mansion need map placement and 3D models in addition to their Shop images; they can ship after the simpler items.
Every real-money purchase over $50 shows the confirmation sheet first; turn on Stripe Radar fraud screening, since higher prices attract chargebacks.
Owner names shown on the yacht, jet banner and mansion gate go through the word filter and can be reset from the Story Studio.

items.name: The Waterfront Mansion
items.description: A glass-and-stone mansion on one of 10 private plots along 'Billionaire's Row' on the Astoria waterfront, with the owner's name on the gate. A real 3D building on the map, lit at night, with a large interior the owner can decorate and invite their crew into. The owner can live in it, but pays a weekly upkeep in C$ equal to the most expensive rent in Astoria, so it never saves money compared with a C$ home. Lola announces each new owner.
items.editionNote: 10 plots total; a refund frees a plot
items.weeklyUpkeepCs: equal to the most expensive Astoria rent (config)

items.name: Statue in the Plaza

Only one statue in the plaza at a time: buyers book an available week. The Story Studio can remove a statue, with a refund.
items.editionNote: 1 per week (at most 52 a year); booking queue
